WITH TPN AS ( ) SELECT DISTINCT PORDERQ.POHFCY_0 AS PurchaseSite, PORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PN, PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 AS PurchaseLine, PORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 AS PurchaseDate, PORDER.BPSNUM_0 AS SupplierCode, BPSUPPLIER.BPSSHO_0 AS SupplierName, PORDERP.ITMDES1_0 AS Description, PORDERP.NETPRI_0 AS NetPrice, PORDERQ.NETCUR_0 AS Currency, PORDERQ.STU_0 AS Unit, PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0 AS QTY, PORDERP.PJT_0 AS ProjectNO FROM TPN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ PORDERQ ON TPN.PN = PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP PORDERP ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PORDERP.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 = PORDERP.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER PORDER ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PORDER.POHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPSUPPLIER BPSUPPLIER ON PORDER.BPSNUM_0 = BPSUPPLIER.BPSNUM_0 WHERE PORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0
ORDER BY PORDERQ.POHFCY_0 DESC, PORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

WITH TPN AS ( ) SELECT PORDERQ.PRHFCY_0 AS PurchaseSite, PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 AS PN, PORDERP.PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 As Line, PORDER.BPSNUM_0 AS SupplierCode, BPSUPPLIER.BPSSHO_0 AS SupplierName, PORDERQ.QTYPUU_0 AS Qty, PORDERQ.PUU_0 AS Unit, PORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 AS PurchaseDate, PRECEIPTD.RCPDAT_0 AS ReceiptDate, DateDiff (day, PORDERQ.ORDDAT_0, PRECEIPTD.RCPDAT_0) AS Duration FROM TPN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ PORDERQ ON PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 = TPN.PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP PORDERP ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PORDERP.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 = PORDERP.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PRECEIPTD PRECEIPTD ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PRECEIPTD.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 = PRECEIPTD.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER PORDER ON PORDER.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPSUPPLIER BPSUPPLIER ON BPSUPPLIER.BPSNUM_0 = PORDER.BPSNUM_0 WHERE PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 != '' AND PORDERQ.QTYPUU_0 > 0
ORDER BY PORDERQ.PRHFCY_0 DESC, PORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
